summary: Frontend validation for 6 fixes on cloud/DC management portal (Indonesian UI). All 7 requested flows PASSED. Verified: (1) credit-note settlement of invoice auto-provisions the linked order — service appears in client My Services, order becomes 'provisioning'/service_delivered, provision_log contains 'payment_verified' step; (2) 'Jalankan Auto-Provision' button (run-provision-{id}) visible for payment_verified/provisioning orders and, on already-provisioned order, backend returns 400 which UI surfaces as native alert 'Service order ini sudah selesai diprovision.' without crash; (3) Reject on a pending_payment order sets its linked invoice to CANCELLED (verified in Admin Invoices UI: INV-2026-00783 CANCELLED); (4) Service in status=terminated hides VMControls/VmMetrics/Upgrade panels and shows 'Layanan telah diakhiri' (terminate-panel) — backend POST /client/services/{sid}/vm/start returns 403 with detail 'Layanan sudah diterminasi - kontrol VM dinonaktifkan.'; (5) restart_required banner (vm-restart-required) renders in amber with upgrade+reboot copy and does NOT mention 'Proxmox'; (6) VNC toolbar exists in code with all required data-testid (vnc-keys-btn, vnc-paste-btn, vnc-power-btn, vnc-keys-menu, vnc-paste-input, vnc-paste-send, vnc-power-menu, vnc-power-{start,shutdown,reset,stop}) and Keys menu enumerates Ctrl+Alt+Del, Esc, Tab, F1..F12; console button is correctly disabled because fake VM is not running — this matches the requested behavior; (7) Regression: AdminOrders, AdminInvoices, AdminCreditNotes, ClientServices rendered with no unexpected console errors (only the intentional 400 on the completed-order provision-retry test).
critical_code_review_comments: ClientServices.jsx: data-testid='terminate-panel' is declared twice (lines 617 and 649) inside TerminateRequestPanel — only one path renders at a time so functionality is OK, but duplicating testids in the same component is a smell; consider distinguishing (e.g., terminate-panel-terminated vs terminate-panel-active) for cleaner selectors.

ClientServices.jsx (763 lines): file is >700 lines and colocates VMControls, VncConsoleModal, ResetPasswordPanel, UpgradePanel, AutoRenewToggle, TerminateRequestPanel, and ServiceDetail — consider splitting into per-panel modules for maintainability.
AdminOrders.jsx: 'Reject' text button (line 85) has no data-testid — added-hoc text selector was needed to click it; adding e.g. data-testid='reject-order-{id}' would improve testability.

Password hash for demo@client.com in seed DB did NOT match the documented password 'DemoClient2026!' — testing agent had to re-hash it in mongo to log in. Recommend making the seed idempotent so preview always has the credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md working.
